name: category
description: FR-BB21 (roadmap section 2.1) -- ports the categories table from c:\Users\tvolo\dev\ai-dala\BilimBaga\backend\migrations\008_categories_tags.up.sql. name is :localized_text with locales ["kk","ru","en"] and search_strategy "plain", queried: true, required: true -- the source column is a bare TEXT, but the category tree is user-facing in a trilingual product and the platform now supports per-locale generated columns (REQ-301), so this is a deliberate upgrade over the source rather than a plain transcription. track is :string, queried: true, not required -- the source column is a nullable TEXT with no CHECK; roadmap 2.1 names three built-in tracks (security, safety, loyalty) but since the source enforces no vocabulary, track stays :string rather than being promoted to :enum with a hard-coded vocabulary the source does not enforce. sort_order is :integer, queried: true, required: true, ported directly. Indexes: idx_category_track over track. No constraints -- the source declares no UNIQUE on categories. No id, created_at, updated_at or created_by field is declared: the record subsystem (Letflow.Entities.Records) mints record identity and the event store carries the audit timeline, so declaring these here would duplicate platform-owned state inside tenant content. No parent_id field is declared: the source's categories.parent_id UUID REFERENCES categories(id) (the category tree) is a self-referential foreign key, and Letflow.Entities.Definition.Validator's Rule 9 (self_referential_fk_violations/1) rejects any fk_def whose references_entity equals the definition's own name today. REQ-324 (pending) lifts that restriction; a follow-on requirement will add parent_id plus its fk_def once REQ-324 lands. This is stated as an honest, deliberate gap -- no unenforced string parent_id, no closure-table entity, and no tree nested in a :json field are used as a workaround.
